fusions.name: Cargo Contagion
fusions.desc: Releases a wave that deals 30 damage, ignoring resistances, to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Gnaw Through
fusions.desc: Spits a gnawed splinter that deals 4 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Last Off the Wreck
fusions.desc: For 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. For 4 seconds after using it, you move 20% faster.

fusions.name: Stowaway Brood
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded familiar of poison that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage.
